funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage with a confirmed publisher and a scheduled publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues or articles on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; higher tier for post‑doctoral level or equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding for research travel, back‑fill, and related costs to undertake British art research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled to start or already undertaking a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: One‑off financial support to help students begin or continue postgraduate study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching eighteenth‑ or nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 total (one year, or split over two years part‑time)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master’s degree that will bring new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK doctoral degree starting between April 2027 and April 2028 (UK‑based or international applicants).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research in British art, covering tuition and living costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals (pre‑doctoral to senior) with at least a first degree.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome with board, accommodation and honorarium for research on British‑Italian topics.
